query:
UPDATE room
        SET
            name = $2,
            description = $3,
            image = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $4 ELSE image END,
            sort_order = $6,
            grid_rows = COALESCE($7, grid_rows),
            features = COALESCE($8, features),
            background_style = COALESCE($9, background_style),
            background_opacity = COALESCE($10, background_opacity),
            last_modified = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id
